semantics.amp_absolute: Controls/Statuses joined by index; TX value = status.min + slider progress
semantics.amp_relative_step: Controls/Statuses joined by index; increment sends01, decrement sendsFF
semantics.asset_selection: first regex match containing decimal user ID, then exact fallback if present; ambiguous matches rejected
semantics.door: plain consumer tests selected bit nonzero; Raise1001001/1001006/1001011 and BSJ9010001 additionally require payload0==1
semantics.method_proof: resolved instruction operands and exact DEX switch/array payload bytes; equality proves reviewed methods only
semantics.radar: byte is cmds.indexOf lookup input; raw code is not centimetres or the displayed proximity index
semantics.settings: hex type/length/command/choice TX; decimal index/bits; empty RX means write-only
